services.name: Snow Bowl Video
services.desc: Bruni’s Snow Bowl Hut rests atop a ridge at 4,250 feet, with a marvelous view of Mt. Rainier, Mt. Adams and Mt. St. Helens. The hut is roomy and comfortable, with most of the comforts of home in the backcountry. The trek to Bruni’s can be quite challenging and you should be in good hiking condition. From the main trail/road, Snow Bowl is approximately 3.0 miles with 1,800’ of elevation gain from the upper sno-park and 4.0 miles with 2,400’ of elevation gain from the lower sno-park. Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 14. One large room and one small room with bunkbeds and floor mats. Water Filter System: Rain water is collected in the summer. Make a cup of cocoa, kick back, and enjoy the warmth of the large stove. During the winter, you will get to listen to the unique sound of snow falling off the roof. Write in the journal or read the stories and experiences of those before you! From the main trail/road, the Yurt is approximately 5.5 miles with 2,200’ of elevation gain from the upper sno-park and 6.5 miles with 2,800’ of elevation gain from the lower sno-park.
